name: VELOCITY
description: 4 or more orders from the same device within a 10-minute window. Detail cites the order ids counted.

name: ADDRESS_MISMATCH
description: Billing city differs from shipping city. Weak signal on its own (could be a gift) — the Auditor requires corroboration.

name: HIGH_VALUE_NEW_CUSTOMER
description: Order total above $900 from a customer with 0 prior orders. Hard signal: backed by the customer history fields on the order itself.

name: CHARGEBACK_HISTORY
description: Customer has 1 or more prior chargebacks in the synthetic history. Hard signal: backed by the customer history fields on the order itself.
